query: select w.id from guest_messages w join invitations i on i.id = w.invitation_id where w.id = $1 and w.invitation_id = $2 and (i.user_id = $3 or exists (select 1 from invitation_members m where m.invitation_id = i.id and m.user_id = $3 and m.revoked_at is null and m.role = any($4))) for update of w
